messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for the SDK snippet + migration note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7823. Need review + merge timing. Targeting the upcoming release branch cut (FF open 2026-04-01). Can we avoid preview drift?
tonY: Looking now. Can we assign @kevin as primary reviewer?
kevin: I can review later today. Quick Q: the snippet uses new client args that only land with model-serving v2. Are we pinning this to versioned docs? If so we should add a short warning.
maria: Yes, pinning to v2. I added a brief migration paragraph titled 'v1 -> v2 runtime note'. Also added a conditional example.
ashley: CI preview is failing — embed example import path changed and build breaks. docs-ci-bot posted the preview link.
docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed for PR #7823 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-7823 (status: failed). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/7823
kevin: I'll fix the import path and push a tiny follow-up. Do we want to hold merge until the FF opens? If it's gated we should schedule merge after 2026-04-01 08:00 UTC.
maria: Hold preferred. If we merge early the live site will show a snippet that doesn't work for users. Proposed plan: hold until FF open, then merge at 08:15 UTC. I'll add a 'hold-until-ff' label.
ashley: :thumbsup: I'll re-run the preview once kevin's fix lands.
kevin: Pushed fix (branch: 7823-quickfix). Also added wording: "This example applies to v2 runtime; see migration guide for v1->v2."
maria: Thanks — can someone do a quick wording pass? @tony?
tonY: On it, will check the live preview when it passes.
ashley: Preview passed now — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-7823 (status: passing).
docs-ci-bot: Preview status: passing. Link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-7823 (deployed at 2026-03-30T22:04:12Z)
maria: Final plan: reviewers kevin + tony, hold merge until FF opens 2026-04-01 08:00 UTC, merge at ~08:15 UTC. Label 'hold-until-ff' applied.
kevin: LGTM after resolving one tiny wording nit — will resolve and approve.
tonY: approved
maria: Merged at 2026-04-01T08:16:02Z after FF open. Closing thread.
